claim: Sebrae and ApexBrasil chose 100 Brazilian startups for the official delegation to Web Summit Lisboa 2026.
source_title: Sebrae e ApexBrasil anunciam startups selecionadas para o Web Summit Lisboa 2026 (Agência Sebrae)
quote: Foram escolhidas 100 startups brasileiras para integrar a delegação oficial

claim: The 40 best-ranked startups get financial support from Sebrae.
source_title: Agência Sebrae, 30 Sep 2026
quote: as 40 empresas mais bem classificadas contarão com apoio financeiro do Sebrae

claim: Sebrae expects about 300 Brazilian startups in the delegation it leads in 2026.
source_title: Agência Sebrae, 30 Sep 2026
quote: a expectativa é reunir cerca de 300 startups brasileiras na delegação liderada pelo Sistema Sebrae em 2026

claim: 12 states (unidades da federação) organise their own missions; the article does not name them.
source_title: Agência Sebrae, 30 Sep 2026
quote: missões estaduais organizadas por 12 unidades da federação

claim: The Sebrae announcement does not list the 100 startups; it links to an ApexBrasil page and names one startup, Vox EPower (Nova Iguaçu, Rio de Janeiro), quoting its co-founder Renan Verli.
source_title: Agência Sebrae, 30 Sep 2026
quote: Renan Verli, co-fundador da Vox EPower

claim: ApexBrasil's results page lists 188 approved companies by tax number (CNPJ) only, no names: 105 confirmed, 33 on the waiting list, 26 awaiting confirmation, 24 withdrawn, with status as of 28 August 2026.
source_title: ApexBrasil | Web Summit Lisboa 2026 [EE-003616]
quote: Lista das empresas APROVADAS com status em 28/8/2026.

claim: ApexBrasil, via Lusa, says about 200 Brazilian companies take part, with a 324 m2 pavilion in the MEO Arena.
source_title: Web Summit: Cerca de 200 empresas brasileiras em Lisboa para captar investimento (Executive Digest / Lusa)
quote: Cerca de 200 empresas brasileiras

claim: IOL (with Link to Leaders, from an ApexBrasil statement) splits the delegation: 99 companies selected for Web Summit's official programme, 90 nominated by partner entities, 50 linked to ten tech hubs. These add to 239, not the headline 200.
source_title: Web Summit 2026: Brasil chega a Lisboa com 200 empresas à procura de investimento (IOL)
quote: 99 empresas ... 90 ... 50

claim: IOL names four hubs: Porto Digital, ACATE, SENAI CIMATEC and Instituto Caldeira.
source_title: IOL
quote: Porto Digital, ACATE, SENAI CIMATEC e Instituto Caldeira

claim: ApexBrasil says Brazil has more than 13,000 active startups; Brazilian companies raised about US$700 million at earlier editions through contacts made there.
source_title: IOL
quote: mais de 13 mil start-ups em atividade

claim: On 10 November an AI pitch competition with representatives of Brazil, France, Portugal and Germany; the startups for the second Lisbon Incubation Programme are announced the same day.
source_title: IOL
quote: 10 de novembro

claim: Sebrae, 4 November: 100 startups prepared since September, 40 funded, 12 states with their own missions, about 300 startups expected in Lisbon; Cristina Mieko, head of Startups at Sebrae Nacional, quoted.
source_title: Startups brasileiras buscam negócios globais no Web Summit Lisboa (starten.tech)
quote: Atualmente, 12 estados organizaram missões próprias para o evento.

claim: Cristina Mieko (Sebrae) lists Brazil's strengths: agribusiness, bioeconomy, energy, sustainability, financial services, health, artificial intelligence and productive inclusion.
source_title: Startups brasileiras buscam clientes e investidores no Web Summit Lisboa (Brasil 247, from Sebrae)
quote: inteligência artificial

claim: ApexBrasil's innovation-environment call for 2026: up to 10 hubs, each nominating 5 startups (up to 50 startups); registration to 30 Aug, startups named by 2 Oct 2026.
source_title: Missão ao Web Summit: Ambientes de Inovação, 9 a 12 de novembro de 2026 (ApexBrasil, PDF)
quote: até 10 Ambientes de Inovação brasileiros ... até 50 startups

claim: The same 2026 rules say the 2025 Brazilian delegation had almost 380 companies, 247 of them supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae Nacional and Serpro, the rest by state Sebraes; Germany and Brazil had the two largest delegations.
source_title: ApexBrasil, Regulamento Ambientes de Inovação 2026
quote: A delegação brasileira contou com quase 380 empresas, sendo 247 startups

claim: The 2026 rules contain a date slip: the mission bullet reads 'Data: 9 a 12 de novembro de 2025' in a document for 2026.
source_title: ApexBrasil, Regulamento Ambientes de Inovação 2026
quote: Data: 9 a 12 de novembro de 2025

claim: For 2025, Startups.com.br reported 340 startups: 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae, 84 by Softex, Anprotec and Serpro; 226 the year before; 123 first-timers. Jorge Viana (ApexBrasil president) said Brazil has more than 20,000 startups.
source_title: ApexBrasil e Sebrae levam 340 startups brasileiras para o Web Summit Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
quote: 256 foram selecionadas pela ApexBrasil e o Sebrae

claim: For 2025, DN Brasil reported more than 370 Brazil-based startups and 151 participants selected by ApexBrasil (80 Southeast, 35 Northeast, 27 South, 6 North, 3 Center-West), and nearly R$94 million in deals in recent years.
source_title: Web Summit: Brasil chega com mais de 370 startups e programação intensa (DN Brasil)
quote: mais de 370 startups sediadas no Brasil

claim: In November 2025 Startups.com.br named ten startups for the Lisbon incubation house: Aiper, Biolinker, Beeviral, 593ican, Hope, SST, Just Travel, SleepUp, Wood Chat, PixNow; chosen from 112 exhibitors with Plug and Play; one floor of a historic building near Avenida da Liberdade shared with Embratur and Fiocruz.
source_title: Governo abre casa brasileira para incubar startups em Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
quote: Just Travel

claim: The 2027 cycle of the Lisbon incubation programme: up to 40 to a strategic exploration stage, top 20 onward, announced during Web Summit; bonus points for HealthTech, EnergyTech, ClimaTech, TravelTech, AgTech, Biotech.
source_title: ApexBrasil e Sebrae selecionam 20 startups brasileiras para incubação em Lisboa (DN Brasil)
quote: Up to 40 ... top 20

claim: Invest.Rio (Rio city's investment agency) and the Maravalley hub take 10 Rio startups to Web Summit Lisboa 2026, second year; Daniel Barros (CEO, Maravalley) and Sidney Levy (president, Invest.Rio) quoted.
source_title: Invest.Rio e Maravalley vão levar 10 startups para o Web Summit Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
quote: 10 startups

claim: Gol pays flights for the 10 Rio startups: Mobile Brain, sheerME, Paralelo.app, Predator Sports & Health, Embeddo, Lucca, Bizuu, Ray Pay, ATLANTICIT, AllPetSenior. Luiz Borrego, CIO of Gol, quoted.
source_title: Gol vai bancar passagens de 10 startups cariocas a Lisboa (Startups.com.br)
quote: Mobile Brain

claim: Correio da Manhã gives the same ten Rio startups and dates the event 8 to 12 November 2026.
source_title: Invest.Rio firma parceria para levar dez startups cariocas ao Web Summit Lisboa (Correio da Manhã)
quote: dez startups cariocas

claim: Session 'Brazil's blueprint for cyber resilience', 12 November 16:10 to 16:20, Stage 8 (Cybersecurity Summit), speaker Wilton Itaiguara Gonçalves Mota, President and CEO, Serpro.
source_title: Brazil's blueprint for cyber resilience (Web Summit)
quote: Wilton Itaiguara Gonçalves Mota, President and CEO, Serpro

claim: Session 'The next digital frontier', 11 November 10:30, Stage 11 (Policy Summit): Vahan Agopyan (Secretary of Science, Technology and Innovation, State of São Paulo), with Bernardo Correia (Secretary of State for Digitalisation, Portugal), Tariq Al Tayer (UAE) and Eleanor Pringle (Fortune). Read by the programme desk 5 Nov.
source_title: The next digital frontier (Web Summit), via desks/programme/agenda.json
quote: Vahan Agopyan

claim: 'German-Brazilian Startup Night', a meetup on 10 November 17:30 to 22:30 at the Gale patio; no hosts, speakers or description on the page.
source_title: German-Brazilian Startup Night (Web Summit)
quote: German-Brazilian Startup Night

claim: ApexBrasil survey: over 13,000 startups, more than 120 investment funds, over 250 innovation hubs, over 30 unicorns; US$2.135 billion VC in 2024 across 386 deals; ApexBrasil supported nearly 100 startups at Web Summit Rio 2026.
source_title: ApexBrasil conecta inovação brasileira a ecossistemas globais com missões em Lisboa e Dubai (ABES)
quote: over 13,000 startups and more than 120 investment funds

claim: 2023: ApexBrasil planned a record delegation of 85 startups and 100 companies, more than double the 80 companies of 2022, the year the Brazil Pavilion debuted.
source_title: Agência de investimento brasileira leva delegação recorde à Web Summit Lisboa (Forbes Portugal / Lusa)
quote: vai levar 85 startups e 100 empresas à Web Summit Lisboa

claim: Opinion by Brazil's ambassador to Portugal, Raimundo Carreiro Silva: about 600 Brazilian participants at Web Summit Lisbon in 2022 and about 1,000 in 2023; Porto Digital Europa in Aveiro's innovation hub offers soft landing to Brazilian startups (10 companies); Unicorn Factory Lisboa ran a competition for Brazilian scaleups.
source_title: A integração dos ecossistemas de inovação do Brasil e de Portugal no contexto do Web Summit (Diário de Notícias, opinion)
quote: Porto Digital Europa
